scan_methodology: Within-object string-aware brace-matched extraction. Tracks { depth, string/quotes, escape sequences. Extracts each complete JSON object, then searches CorrectChoice and ExplanationWrong fields within the same object boundary. This avoids the DL-029 class of false positives (forward-scan pairing CorrectChoice from object N+1 with ExplanationWrong from object N).
